title: Report early native S0 refusal when local naming authority cannot supply a binding
outcome: A refused local native opening tells the agent that native declared-command credit is unavailable, while provider enqueue and conservative credit admission remain unchanged.
acceptance: An early local naming-authority refusal surfaces a bounded opening refusal notice through the existing notice path.
Provider enqueue remains free of synchronous Engram authority RPCs; uncertain openings still receive no native credit.
Behavioral coverage checks the delivered refusal notice and unchanged provider handoff and credit refusal.
